identity.name: MEGADOCK CPU/GPU fixture recording, science step s29
identity.scope: Four fixture holo test-set pairs in comparison_view.json, standard 3600 rotations, 50 predictions. A2 duplicates A0; A3 duplicates A1. This recording is not the seed apo or denser-search experiment.

found_evidence: Pinned public source, published build and command guides, exact arm commands in the supplied comparison view, and accessible required inputs.

outputs.name: transforms
outputs.what: The rotation and translation fields of every ranked prediction row of the arm's docking.out (all fields of the row except the last), in file order.

outputs.name: scores
outputs.what: The score field (the last field) of every ranked prediction row of the arm's docking.out, in file order.

outputs.name: coords
outputs.what: The x, y and z coordinate columns of every ATOM and HETATM record of the arm's assembled models, models taken in rank order.

outputs.name: dockq
outputs.what: The evaluator's DockQ value for each of the arm's assembled models, as one JSON array in rank order, in a file that holds no other number.

metrics.name: wall
metrics.what: Trusted wall of the invocation: adapter and arm commands, plus the evaluator part.

outcome_definition.evaluation: One DockQ value for each assembled ranked model, in rank order. Pipeline performs comparisons; intake and adapters compute no differences, tolerances or summaries.

requirements: CUDA toolkit including nvcc and cuobjdump
stock_cuda_image.gpu_target: Read compute_cap using the brief command, compile for that single target and verify its presence with cuobjdump; no target is assumed.

resources.reason: Only required fixture source bytes are known; peak CPU/GPU FFT working set and evaluator memory are not published for these cases. Full PINDER corpus is not required.

interface.what: The published DockQ implementation of PINDER (pinder_eval, BiotiteDockQ) at the pinned source, scoring each assembled model of one invocation against the input's native complex with the model's chains R and L mapped to the native's receptor and ligand chains.

spec.private_data: for each input, the native complex named in spec.reference, fetched by fetch_private.sh from its URL and checked against its SHA-256 and byte count. fetch_private.sh is self-contained: it carries each input's reference name, URL, byte count and SHA-256 in its own text and reads no other file under harness/, because only the sealed comparison files and the usual harness scripts are uploaded to the box.
spec.reads: the model_<rank>.pdb files under CMP_ARM_OUT, in rank order; the native complex under CMP_PRIVATE at the name, byte count and SHA-256 given by spec.reference in CMP_INPUT_SPEC
spec.invocation: BiotiteDockQ is constructed with parallel_io=False (models read in the evaluator's own process). evaluate.sh is self-contained: it carries the evaluator's Python program in its own text, writes it at each call to a regular file under CMP_EVAL_OUT, and runs it as the venv interpreter followed by that file's path. It never runs a program read from standard input (PINDER's parallel reader starts its workers with the spawn method, which re-imports the main program from its file) and never runs or reads any other file under harness/, which is not uploaded to the box.
spec.writes: CMP_EVAL_OUT/dockq.json, one JSON array of the DockQ values in rank order and no other number; any per-model detail goes to a separate file under CMP_EVAL_OUT

scoring.reason: Brief explicitly states no published anchors for these fixture inputs. No acceptance tolerances supplied; none invented.
scoring.comparison_rules: Pipeline records and compares outputs. No agent or adapter computes or asserts arm differences or summaries.

repeatability.seeds_reason: No random seed is specified in the published commands or comparison view.
repeatability.failure_policy: Preserve all invocation files, failures and timeouts; do not rerun outside the pipeline schedule.

A1.what: Seed configuration 2: the published MEGADOCK GPU build with the same sampling and scientific settings as A0, followed by the same reconstruction and assembly as A0.
commands: set -euo pipefail; for r in $(seq 1 50); do baseline-published/megadock/decoygen "lig_$r.pdb" "$2" "$0/docking.out" "$r" > "decoygen_$r.log" 2>&1; grep -v '^END' "$1" > "$0/model_$r.pdb"; grep -v -E '^(END|ENDMDL)' "lig_$r.pdb" >> "$0/model_$r.pdb"; echo END >> "$0/model_$r.pdb"; done
A1.commands_source: comparison_view.json; MEGADOCK doc/README.md documents executable options and decoygen; model assembly is supplied by the comparison view
